Docs

402xAgent checks an x402 endpoint right before your agent pays: pay, skip or recheck.

Checks read target terms on Base and Solana; paying 402xAgent itself is USDC on Base only.

  • OpenAPI spec: every route, parameter and price
  • Rules: verdicts, reason codes and confidence (JSON: /rules.json)
  • llms.txt: plain-text overview for agents
  • Pricing: free and paid tiers
  • Receipts: public check receipts
  • Skips: endpoints that disagree with their listing
  • MCP: POST https://api.402xagent.com/mcp (JSON-RPC, tools listed by tools/list)
  • Client guard for @x402/fetch and @x402/axios: github.com/withgrokbot/x402-spotcheck

Quick start

Free check, no signup: GET https://api.402xagent.com/v1/products/endpoint-spot-check?url=<endpoint>&mode=dry-run

Endpoint report ($0.05): what the locked teasers hide

Live. Every free check answer carries a locked block with two teasers: drift (for example "2 changes in 30d": a count only, never which terms or when) and hygiene (a grade: A = quality_ok, C = bad content type, D = schema mismatch, F = bad status or unreachable, "–" plus a reason when there is nothing to validate). Next to it, locked_commitments holds one sha256: digest per locked item (drift_history, hygiene_detail) and a ref (cm-…), valid for 30 days.

Buy the report: POST https://api.402xagent.com/v1/products/endpoint-report with JSON {"url":"https://api.402rates.com/v1/ping","commitment_ref":"cm-0123456789abcdef"} and an x402 payment of $0.05 USDC on Base (no free tier; the same price for everyone). The signed er- receipt reveals exactly the committed snapshots (which terms changed, when, from what to what; the full hygiene checks) with their nonces. Add "include_current": true to also get today's stored data under current, which the commitment does not cover. Without a commitment_ref the report commits and reveals in one step.

Verify a report

  1. Keep locked_commitments from your free check.
  2. For each key k: compute "sha256:" + hex(sha256(JCS({snapshot: revealed[k].snapshot, nonce: revealed[k].nonce}))) (RFC 8785 canonical JSON; the nonce is 32 bytes hex).
  3. It must equal locked_commitments[k]. A changed snapshot, a different nonce or newer data gives a different digest.
  4. Verify the receipt's ed25519 signature with the kid in /.well-known/402xagent-keys.json (see receipt signatures below).

Public views of every receipt (sc-, ps-, er-) never show buyer wallets, payment payloads, nonces of your payment, settle transactions or client IPs.

Watchtower ($1 per 30 days)

Watch one x402 endpoint: POST https://api.402xagent.com/v1/watch with JSON {"url":"https://api.402rates.com/v1/ping","method":"GET","webhook_url":"https://hooks.example.com/402x"}. The first watch per webhook domain gets a 7-day free trial (shared relay hosts such as webhook.site or hooks.slack.com count per full URL); otherwise pay $1 USDC via x402. We probe the endpoint once for a baseline and send a signed watch.verify event that must get a 2xx within 5 s; nothing is charged if either fails. The answer carries watch_secret once.

Every hour we re-probe. Events: drift (payTo, network, asset, price > 1 %, x402 version, schemes or paywall changed, seen on 2 probes in a row), down and recovery (2 probes in a row), flapping, paused, resumed. Each webhook POST carries X-402x-Signature (Ed25519, base64url) over timestamp + "." + body, X-402x-Kid, X-402x-Timestamp and X-402x-Event-Id; verify with the keys doc and reject a skew over 5 minutes. Retries: 1 m, 5 m, 30 m, 2 h, 6 h with the same event id. After 3 days on which every delivery failed, the watch pauses; a 2xx POST /v1/watch/wt-0123456789abcdef/verify (Bearer) or a renew resumes it.

Renew: POST https://api.402xagent.com/v1/watch/wt-0123456789abcdef/renew with $1 adds 30 days. Status: GET https://api.402xagent.com/v1/watch/wt-0123456789abcdef with Authorization: Bearer wts_.... On expiry a watch pauses, it is never deleted. We never store payer wallets or transaction hashes.

After you pay: payment status

Your paid call timed out, or came back 5xx or an empty 402. Did the money move? POST https://api.402xagent.com/v1/products/payment-status with JSON {"payment_payload":"<base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE you sent>","seller_url":"<url you paid>"} (or tx_hash, or from + nonce + valid_before). Base USDC (EIP-3009 exact) only for now.

  • status: landed (on-chain, 10+ confirmations), not_landed, pending (could still land, or too few confirmations), canceled, unknown.
  • safe_to_retry_same_payload: always true. An EIP-3009 nonce is single-use, so resending the same signed payment can never charge twice.
  • safe_to_resign: true only when two independent RPC sources agree the nonce is unused and the chain is past validBefore + 120 s. Any doubt, disagreement, single source or error means false: don't sign a new payment yet (see wait_until).
  • Also: the tx (amount, payTo, block, confirmations), a match against the seller's 402 terms, who to claim from and with what evidence, and what we can't know (delivery, seller state, facilitator internals, reorgs).
  • Every answer carries a signed copy in receipt (same keys as below). Same price as the check, $0.02, and the same 5 free per day. A bare request returns the x402 402. In x402-spotcheck 1.2.0: afterPay() or spotCheckFetch(fetch, { afterPay: true }).

Worked example: a paid call that timed out but settled (402rates-ping, Oct 16, 2026)

A real case from our own client. Facts only; times are Pacific (UTC-7).

  • 10:49:28: the seller's 402 asked $0.001 (amount 1000, USDC on Base) to payTo 0xf567…cb98, maxTimeoutSeconds 300. The client signed and sent the paid retry.
  • ~10:49:48: the client gave up after 20,359 ms. No response body was delivered.
  • 10:51:19: the authorization settled on-chain in block 52691866 (tx 0x2b4cc694…13ee, from 0x37cf…8674 (our payTo; Verified owner), relayer 0xa32c…d101).
  • 11:12:28: one free payment-status check with tx_hash, from, nonce and seller_url (no payload needed when you have these).

Answer: status landed (reason settled_onchain, 634 confirmations), amount and payTo match the seller's 402 terms, two RPC sources (Alchemy and Infura) agreed, safe_to_resign false. So: don't sign a new payment; the money moved, and the next step is to ask the seller for the response or a refund, using the tx as evidence. Signed receipt: https://402xagent.com/v1/receipts/ps-65a4fdffae01d2b6.

Facilitator pre-settle check (free)

For a facilitator's onBeforeSettle hook: POST https://api.402xagent.com/v1/facilitator/check with JSON {"paymentRequirements":{"scheme":"exact","network":"eip155:8453","amount":"1000","asset":"0x8335…2913","payTo":"0x…"},"url":"https://seller.example/api"} (the url may also come from resource or paymentRequirements.resource). We re-read the seller's live 402 terms for that resource with the same unpaid probe as the check (private, loopback and link-local addresses blocked on every redirect, 8 s timeout, 64 KB cap; never pays) and compare scheme, network (CAIP-2), amount, asset and payTo (EVM addresses case-insensitive).

Answer: {match, mismatches:[{field, expected, live}], live_terms_sha256, checked_at, recommendation}. recommendation is settle only when one live accepts entry matches every field; anything else is hold, including 400 (bad input or blocked url), 429 (60 per minute per caller IP, or 30 probes per minute per seller host across all callers; nothing is probed then), 502 (seller unreachable), 503 (busy, or our rate limiter is unavailable; we then probe nothing) and 504 (seller timed out). live_terms_sha256 = sha256 of network|asset|amount|payTo, the same formula as payment_terms_sha256. Free for now; it does not use the check's 5 free per day. Send only the requirements: a payment payload is ignored, never stored and never echoed, and nothing about the payer is logged.

Expiry check (opt-in)

Add &check_expiry=1 to endpoint-spot-check (optional &skew_s= 0 to 300, default 30). If the check would say pay but every Base USDC option in the live 402 is already expired, or expires within skew_s (extra.validBefore, expiresAt, expiry or deadline; or maxTimeoutSeconds of 5 or less), the verdict is skip with reason challenge_expired, and the answer and receipt carry an expiry_check block. Without the parameter nothing changes. In x402-spotcheck 1.4.0: { checkExpiry: true }.

Hosted mode (integrator keys)

For routers and wallets that run checks for many agents. Opt in by asking us for a key, then send Authorization: Bearer 402x_live_<id>_<secret> (or x-402xagent-key) on the check or on payment status. Optionally add x-402xagent-end-user: <your opaque agent id>; we store only a salted hash of it.

  • Price: 1,000 free hosted checks per integrator (lifetime), then $0.02 per check; each billable check after the first 1,000 in a UTC calendar month is $0.01. Cached answers count. Billed on a monthly USDC invoice on Base, not per call.
  • With a key there is no daily free counter and no x402 per call; a payment header is ignored. Credit limit $20 until the first invoice is paid, then $100; over it, calls fall back to the normal free tier + x402 (response header x-402xagent-hosted: fallback: credit_limit).
  • Answers are the full (paid-shape) answer. Receipts are signed and show tier/access_tier hosted with a hosted block: integrator id, end-user hash, price_atomic, band (free_allowance, standard, volume), month and billed_on: invoice.
  • Your meter: GET /v1/integrators/me with the same key. A bad, suspended or revoked key gets 401 (never a silent free check); 120 checks per minute per key.
  • Requests without a key are unchanged. In x402-spotcheck 1.3.0: spotCheckFetch(fetch, { mode: "service", apiKey }).

Receipt signatures

New receipts (/v1/receipts/<id>) carry kid and signature: ed25519 (base64url, 64 bytes) over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON of the receipt with only signature removed. Public keys: /.well-known/402xagent-keys.json (match kid). Older receipts are unsigned. A signature proves 402xAgent issued the receipt; it does not change the verdict.

Offline, with x402-spotcheck 1.1.0+: await verifyReceipt(receipt, { publicKey }). Or with Node 20+ and no dependencies:

import { createPublicKey, verify } from "node:crypto";
const jcs = (v) => v === null || typeof v !== "object" ? JSON.stringify(v)
  : Array.isArray(v) ? "[" + v.map(jcs).join(",") + "]"
  : "{" + Object.keys(v).filter((k) => v[k] !== undefined).sort().map((k) => JSON.stringify(k) + ":" + jcs(v[k])).join(",") + "}";
const receipt = await (await fetch("https://402xagent.com/v1/receipts/sc-...")).json();
const { keys } = await (await fetch("https://api.402xagent.com/.well-known/402xagent-keys.json")).json(); // or a saved copy
const jwk = keys.find((k) => k.kid === receipt.kid);
const { signature, ...signed } = receipt;
const ok = verify(null, Buffer.from(jcs(signed)), createPublicKey({ key: { kty: "OKP", crv: "Ed25519", x: jwk.x }, format: "jwk" }), Buffer.from(signature, "base64url"));
console.log(ok ? "valid" : "INVALID");
